title: A Compass on the Quantum State Sphere: The Hopf Ansatz for Arbitrary Pure-State Optimization
summary: Optimizing an arbitrary pure state requires more than a circuit that can prepare it: one also needs coordinates, local distance information, and measurable derivative directions. We introduce the Hopf ansatz, a binary-tree circuit for arbitrary normalized real and complex state vectors. Internal angles split probability between subtrees, while leaf phases supply the complex degrees of freedom.
